verdict.reasoning: The printed page (IV-2) shows '2.1.4 Brackets, Braces, and Choice Indicators' as a run-in heading set exactly like 2.1.3, 2.1.5 and 2.1.6 on the same page. The markdown (specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md line 6275; page-148.md line 11) carries the identical text, word for word, in the same position; the body text of 2.1.4 follows it unchanged. The claim's own pdf_says and markdown_says are identical. The only difference is markdown heading markup ('####' absent), which is formatting, not content: no word, rule or meaning differs. The claim is also incomplete on its own terms: 2.1.3, 2.1.5 and 2.1.6 on this page are equally plain lines while 2.1.1, 2.1.2 and 2.1.7 are '####' headings, so if heading-level consistency is wanted it is a sweep of the whole 2.1.x run, not a 2.1.4 content defect.
